product.description: Supervalue 10 pack of Fernox F1 Protector, a market-leading inhibitor which prevents corrosion and limescale formation in central heating systems. This high-performance product offers superior protection by uniquely combining three inhibitors of organic particles, which bind to the metal within the heating system to protect from debris alongside anodic inhibitors which react with the system&rsquo;s metal surface to create a protective layer, and cathodic inhibitors that combine with hard water salts to form an insoluble layer. Fernox Protector F1 also includes enhanced pH buffering to ensure the system water pH level does not drop below 6.5 or above 8.5 &ndash; the optimum pH range for preventing corrosion and limescale build-up. In line with BS 7593:2019 regulations and best practice, and for long-term protection of the system, concentration levels should be maintained and checked annually as part of the boiler or system service. Protector F1 is compatible with all other Fernox products and is suitable for use with all materials and metals used in central heating systems, including aluminium.

Smartseal's Solvent-Free Block Paving Sealer is a professional grade solvent-free sealer. This sealer will harden freshly laid sand which will stop weeds from growing from the joints. It will also seal the blocks, which will protect from staining.

The Water Regulations Advisory Scheme is a certification mark that demonstrates that an item complies with the high standards set out by water regulations. Here at SecureFix Direct we stock a huge selection of items for your caravan and motorhome adventures. We currently stock a huge array of electrical components, including these Flush Fitting Electric Inlet Sockets.

product.name: Faringdon Traditional Thermostatic Radiator Valve - Antique Brass (Angled TRV)
product.description:
The Faringdon radiator valve is a traditional thermostatic valve. It has some excellent features like the real wood wheel head top grade material brass and high quality polish to ensure it stands apart from its contemporaries. Thermostatic valves allow you to alter the temperature of your room easily by pre-selecting your desired temperature and letting the radiator automatically achieve the correct heat output. The range has a choice of desirable finishes that mean you can match your valve perfectly to your radiator.

We recommend all thermostatic radiator valves (TRV's) are installed on the flow rather than the return pipework of a radiator. When used in conjunction with a system automatic bypass valve this thermostatic valve can be installed on either the flow or return in any orientation. System automatic bypass valves are a specific building regulation requirement for all new installations and boiler upgrades. All bi-directional TRV's from any manufacturer require the bypass valve to function correctly and thus avoid radiator hammer.

Better to upgrade rather than replacing the toilet

Round Wall Hook Complete Product Introduction
Material

    The whole hook is made of 304 stainless steel with integrated stamping molding for stable structure. The surface is professionally treated with multi-layer protective coating, delivering excellent waterproof, moisture-proof and rust-proof performance,

Dimensions (Single Hook)
Base diameter: 6 cm
Base side thickness: 1.5 cm
Front knob diameter: 2.8 cm
Projection from base surface to knob: 3 cm


Available Colors

    Black, Silver, Polished Chrome, White, Grey, Gold, Rosegold

Selling Specification

    Sold as a set of 2 pieces. Each hook is packed in a separate box and delivered as a complete set.

Application Scenarios

    Bathroom: Hang towels, bath towels, bath sponges, bath brushes and washing supplies. The stainless steel material resists moisture and rust.
    Entryway: Organize keys, hats, scarves, face masks, handbags and shopping bags.
    Bedroom &amp; Wardrobe: Hold camisoles, belts, hair accessories and lightweight garments.

Important Notes

    The traceless adhesive only works on smooth and solid surfaces: ceramic tile, glass, smooth solid wood, flat latex paint wall. It cannot adhere firmly to wallpaper, wall fabric, diatom mud, powdery walls, hollow walls or uneven surfaces. Screw installation
        is recommended for these surfaces.
    Do not hang any items within the 24-hour curing period. Early loading will easily cause the hook to fall off.
    For long-term use in humid areas, regularly wipe off accumulated water on the hook surface to extend coating service life and prevent water marks.

product.name: ILCOM SLOPED RIGHT FLOOR SHOWER PROFILE LKP 11mm x 1800mm x 0.6mm Copper Brushed Stainless Steel
product.description:
SLOPED Right FLOOR SHOWER PROFILE

2% reduction SUS 304 stainless steel | PVD

Sloping strips for a linear drain are the best solution if you value a professional approach to finishing your bathroom. Thanks to the shower tray strip, your shower will acquire a neat and elegant look. The slope strip is intended to mask the unsightly end of the tiles and at the same time allow a slope towards the drain without the need to cut the tiles into an "envelope". The strip forces a 2% fall, so you can be sure that your shower is perfect in every respect, both technically and visually.

Choose a practical solution:

Aesthetic finish of the track without visible silicones, no need to cut the tiles in a bag to speed up and increase the comfort of the tiler's work.

Need more arguments? The specifications of our decorative strips are another vote in favor of using them in your home: SUS 304 stainless steel; thickness appropriate to the thickness of the enamel; dimensional accuracy thanks to the use of laser cutting; durable, light-resistant and non-abrasive color obtained in the PVD process high thermal resistance; resistance to chemical agents. A product in the spirit of DIY The main advantage of our shower tray strips is their ease of installation and cutting.

Any beginner DIY enthusiast can handle them without any problems. All you need for installation is tile adhesive and silicone, while cutting can be done with an angle grinder or a saw blade. That's all you need to easily achieve a beautiful visual effect. 

length: 120/180 cm
profile width: 1.0 cm up to 3.0/4.0 cm 
Material: SUS 304 stainless steel, PVD coloring method, can be cut to size with angle grinder or metal shears
application: flooring

STAINLESS STEEL FRONT SHOWER PROFILE

Linear drain trim strips are the best solution for those who appreciate a professional approach to their bathroom finish.
The trim strip is the ideal complement to bathroom trim strips.
It gives the entire finish a cohesive, aesthetic look and helps maintain a uniform level of joints throughout the room.

Choose a practical solution:
• Achieve a complete and consistent finish;

• SUS 304 stainless steel;
• thickness suitable for enamel thickness;
• dimensional accuracy thanks to laser cutting;
• durable, lightfast, and non-abrasive color achieved thanks to the PVD process;

• and chemical resistance.

A product with a DIY spirit:
The main advantage of our shower tray trims is their ease of installation and cutting.
Any avid DIYer can handle them without problems.
All you need for installation is tile adhesive and silicone, while cutting can be done with an angle grinder or saw blade.
This is all you need to easily achieve a beautiful visual effect.

How to choose the right strip?
Remember that strips are available in two standard lengths: 130 cm and 180 cm.

Important note :
If you use the 180 cm side profile (LPSP 180 cm) and also want to use the front profile (LC) on the front part of the shower tray,
then due to compatibility this profile must be purchased in the 180 cm version (LC 180 cm).
Likewise, the 120 cm side profile (LPSP 120 cm) must be used with the front profile (LC) of the 130 cm shower tray (LC 130 cm).

product.name: Ibc s60x6 Extender Kit 20mm Mdpe Tee To Link To 20mm  Mdpe Pipe
product.description: IBC Tank Linking Kit with Outlet Extender – 2" S60x6 Coarse Thread Product Description: This high-quality IBC tank linking kit is designed for tanks featuring a 2" S60x6 coarse threaded outlet. IBC tanks (Intermediate Bulk Containers) are large, reusable storage units used for holding and transporting liquids such as water, chemicals, or food products. Built with a strong metal frame and a recessed outlet valve, they are perfect for a wide range of applications—from rainwater harvesting and irrigation to industrial fluid storage. However, the recessed outlet can make connecting taps or pipe fittings awkward and time-consuming. That’s where this extender kit comes in. The included outlet extender brings the thread clear of the tank’s frame, making it quick and easy to attach fittings or link multiple tanks together. This kit includes MDPE (Medium-Density Polyethylene) water pipe fittings, allowing you to create a secure and watertight connection between tanks or between a tank and your plumbing setup. Available Fitting Options: Sizes: 20mm, 25mm, or 32mm Types: Elbow, Tee, or Straight connection Optional Flow Control Valve for easy regulation of water flow Typical Uses: Linking multiple IBC tanks for increased water storage capacity Connecting tanks to irrigation or garden watering systems Rainwater harvesting setups Industrial and agricultural water management Key Features & Benefits: Extends the recessed IBC outlet for easy access and connection Compatible with standard 2" S60x6 coarse thread outlets Durable, watertight fittings suitable for long-term outdoor use Multiple fitting sizes and styles to suit your setup Optional flow control valve for convenient operation Simplify your IBC tank setup with this all-in-one linking kit—making tank connection, water transfer, and system management effortless.

product.name: Fastwarm 200W Electric Underfloor Heating Cable Kit - 1.75m2 - Digital Thermostat
product.description: Fastwarm 200w heating cable kits are industry leading heating systems that can be used as a primary heat source.    Fastwarm heating cable comprise of the thinnest (2mm) fluoropolymer (Teflon) coated, dual-core resistive heating cable on the market. The cables can be spaced at 50mm intervals to provide an even heat distribution. The cable system allows for use in small confined areas (bathrooms and en suites) plus complicated shaped areas, making fitting a FastWarm underfloor heating cable suitable for any DIY enthusiast.    Fastwarm 200w heating cable kits come with a peace of mind lifetime guarantee (50 years) as we only use the highest quality components sourced across the globe. Fastwarm heating cables use Teflon as an outer coating rather than PVC, meaning you can rest assured that once installed, your Fastwarm underfloor heating system will last a lifetime.

product.name: Aquarius Underfloor Heating Kit - 200w - 10sqm Mat - White Digital Thermostat
product.description:
Introducing the AQUARIUS Electric Underfloor Heating Kit - this versatile system is well-suited for a variety of rooms, including kitchens, lounges, dining rooms, and numerous other areas.

The 200W Electric Underfloor Heating Mat offers a 25% faster warm-up time, outperforming other wattage heating mats. It's perfect for high heat loss areas in your home. This version is the most powerful yet.

Aquarius Electric Underfloor Heating Mats offer a dependable and efficient solution for underfloor heating. They can be used with various types of floor coverings, including tiles, stone, ceramic or similar flooring. This advanced electric underfloor heating mat is the result of cutting-edge engineering. It features two key elements: meticulously spaced 2mm heating wire for optimal heat output and a robust sticky glass fibre mesh mat with a super-strong self-adhesive backing for your project's fastest, most secure installation. Our handy kit contains everything you need for installation.

Kit Includes:

Underfloor Heating Sticky Mat (Two individual mats if kit size over 12m2)
Floor Primer - a high-performance universal priming/sealing agent suitable for plaster, timber, brick, and block work.
Roller - a high-quality roller for applying floor primer to the subfloor
Adhesive tape - works to assist in holding a mat or cable in position during installation
2m Floor Sensor Probe Conduit - provides a protective pathway for the sensor probe, connecting to your thermostat
